run.change_description: Enable Flow typings on errors tests + Fix typing for Error constructor

summary.intent: Turn on Flow typing (@flow strict) for the errors tests and inspect-test, and widen the GraphQLError constructor's declared `nodes` parameter to accept `null` so the tests type-check (commit-7e39a12; PR body empty).
summary.issue_fit: Issue alignment unavailable: no originating issue; intent taken from the commit message and the supplied PR text. Both ledger rows are met, but the retyping of one test silently drops its stack-less-original scenario.
summary.coverage: Complete merge-base diff of all 5 files reviewed. Focused mocha run once at head on src/error/__tests__/*-test.js and src/jsutils/__tests__/inspect-test.js in a scratch export: 27 passing. Flow itself was not run (not permitted by the run allowance). The prior thread by IvanGoncharov on GraphQLError.js:25 (nodes accepts undefined but not null) is addressed by the head's added `| null`; the supplied packet has no later state. Uncommitted changes: none. One verification batch (initial) confirmed the finding; the verifier's narrower trigger is used.

findings.title: Restore a stack-less original error in the 'no stack' test
findings.trigger: The test now builds `original` with `new Error('original')`, which always has a truthy `stack`, so it takes only the `originalError.stack` branch. Removing the `&& originalError.stack` guard at src/error/GraphQLError.js:195 (a truthy but stack-less original, e.g. a non-Error thrown value wrapped by locatedError, then gets `stack` undefined) fails the merge-base test but passes every head test.
findings.impact: The regression protection this test gave for wrapping a stack-less original error is lost; the test's title still claims it.
findings.change: In src/error/__tests__/GraphQLError-test.js keep a stack-less original, typed for Flow: `const original: any = { message: 'original' };`.
